answer: Each new agent is admitted only after locking a non-transferable deposit in a glacier vault frozen for ninety days. Admission also requires a reef of five unaffiliated incumbents, each posting a slashable surety, plus a unique sonnet: a fourteen-clause hash-committed work receipt bound to that vault. When a cluster of common control is proven, the frozen deposit and every surety are burned. Spawning N sybils therefore costs N season-long locked bonds, N distinct work receipts, and five independent sponsors per fake seat—outlays that scale linearly and cannot be recycled until the thaw.
